## Who Is Vishal Hingol?

Vishal Hingol is a self-help author, mindset coach, and publisher based in India.
With 14+ years of experience in digital print media, he turned to writing books to share
what he has learned about human psychology, behaviour change, and personal transformation.

He writes at the intersection of neuroscience, psychology, and spiritual practice — grounded
in the belief that the gap between where people are and where they want to be is a gap of
frequency, and frequency can be learned.

His flagship work is *Zara and the Divine Signal* — a cosmic coming-of-age story about
a girl, an old radio, and a signal that should not exist. He is best known for his work
on the 369 manifestation method, subconscious reprogramming, self-sabotage patterns,
digital sovereignty, and practical AI for business.

**Author page on Amazon:** https://www.amazon.com/stores/Vishal-Hingol/author/B0H28TNG37
**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/authorvishalhingol
**Twitter/X:** https://x.com/Authorvhingol

### Visionary Fiction (6 books)

- **Zara and the Divine Signal** — A cosmic coming-of-age story. A girl, an old radio,
  and a signal that should not exist. How the signal works, what the noise costs, and
  what becomes possible when you choose to transmit what you actually are.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

- **The Architecture of Destiny** — A novel of shadows, invention, and the life no one
  saw coming. Destiny is not found. It is built. A quiet architecture beneath every
  life that looks ordinary from the outside.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

- **The Mechanic of Redemption** — Daniel Reyes had the Wall Street title, the
  Westchester house, everything money could buy — then lost it all. A story of
  homelessness, an old mechanic's wisdom, and the slow unglamorous work of rebuilding
  a life one honest day at a time.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

- **The Real Frequency of Origins** — In a city drowning in noise, one woman starts
  receiving answers to questions she never asked aloud. A novel about origins, signals,
  and what happens when the universe finally talks back.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

- **The Real Architect of Echoes** — Reality is not random. It is responding. A story
  about the echoes we send into the world, the ones that return, and the moment a man
  realises he has been the architect of both all along.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

- **The Real Resonance Threshold** — A mind-bending sci-fi thriller exploring the
  boundary between consciousness and quantum reality. When transformation becomes possible
  at the frequency level, nothing about who you are remains the same.
  https://vishalhingolauthor.com/store.html

## Services

### 1:1 Mindset Mentorship
**Page:** https://vishalhingolauthor.com/mentor.html

Work directly with Vishal in private one-to-one sessions. For people who have read the
books and want the next level — someone who truly listens, then gives an honest perspective
on their best next move.

**Who it's for:**
- People who can name their pattern (self-sabotage, limiting belief) but knowing hasn't
  been enough to change it
- People who want to move faster with someone who can see their specific blind spot
- People ready for direct, honest conversation — not more affirmations

**How it works:**
1. Free 20-minute intro call — talk through where you're actually stuck. No pitch, no pressure.
2. A plan built around you — not a fixed package, a mentorship structure shaped by what
   you actually need.
3. Ongoing 1:1 sessions — regular calls, direct honesty, real accountability.

**Pricing:**
- Single Session: $29 / 45-minute video call
- Monthly Mentorship: $99/month — 4 sessions + WhatsApp access between calls, cancel anytime

**Payment:** PayPal and Razorpay. Accepted from anywhere in the world.
**Availability:** Worldwide via video call — USA, UK, Canada, Australia, India, Japan,
South Korea, Dubai, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Europe, and beyond.
**Response time:** Vishal reads every inquiry personally and replies within 2–3 days.

**Topics covered:** Self-sabotage, limiting beliefs, the 369 method, manifestation in
practice, loneliness and isolation, finding purpose, intentional living, mindset for men,
digital sovereignty, subconscious reprogramming.
